target.title: fix(telegram): report inbound media download failures
target.body:
Closes #100000

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Telegram users sending media would receive no diagnostic when Telegram's `getFile` call failed. The message could continue with only a media placeholder, while the attachment was neither saved nor delivered to the model; files above Telegram Bot API's 20 MB download ceiling hit this path consistently.

## Why This Change Was Made

Inbound `getFile` failures now use the existing typed media-error path instead of returning `null`. Transient failures remain eligible for durable spool retry, Telegram `retry_after` is honored inside a shutdown-aware 20-minute overall deadline, static stickers follow the same failure contract, and the permanent Bot API size failure reports the lower of Telegram's 20 MB ceiling and the configured media limit.

## User Impact

Telegram users now receive a reply on failed media downloads instead of a silently incomplete agent turn. Oversized files receive an accurate maximum-size warning, while transient failures—including 429 responses—retain their retryable status for spooled delivery.

## Evidence

- Focused regression suite: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media-retry.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.media.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot.create-telegram-bot.channel-post-media.test.ts` — 56 tests passed.
- Final autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
- Testbox changed-surface gate: `tbx_01kwq57s8g8qrxy5dvabys9yg1` — extension production/tests typecheck, lint, database/media/runtime guards, and import-cycle check passed. [Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28715179633)
- Real Telegram baseline on current `main`: a 21 MiB document produced no warning, saved no inbound file, and reached the model only as a document placeholder.
- Real Telegram final-source proof: the same 21 MiB document received `⚠️ File too large. Maximum size is 20MB.`, created zero model requests, and created zero inbound files. Small photo and document controls were saved and reached the model.
- Dependency contract checked against grammY 1.43.0 source (`Context.getFile(signal?)`, `GrammyError.error_code`, response parameters) and the [Telegram Bot API `getFile` contract](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getfile).
